Prior to the administration of corporal punishment, the student receiving the corporal punishment shall be given an explanation of the reasons for the punishment and be given an opportunity to refute the charges.

candidates: Corporal punishment is defined as paddling with a board on the buttocks.
Paddling shall be administered only by certificated personnel.
The paddling must be witnessed by another certificated employee, shall consist of no more than three swats at any one time, and will occur outside of the classroom.
IV Board of Education Rules and Regulations state that corporal punishment shall be used only as a last resort when all other means of attempts at punishment and correction of a student has failed.
When deemed acceptable, pupils may choose to be paddled in lieu of suspension and/or other disciplinary procedures.
* Corporal Punishment Corporal punishment by certified staff may be administered to any pupil, as a measure of correction or of maintaining discipline and order in schools, is permitted.

JGA) The district reserves the right to use corporal punishment for all students in 1st or 2nd offense situations when the principal feels it would be more effective and appropriate means of correction and/or when parents request it as a first alternative rather than using other forms of discipline.
JGD) Parents will be notified by discipline report, mail or phone if their child has received out-of-school suspension, in-school suspension, or corporal punishment.
